title: Kookie UI Button Components
description: Complete JSON Schema collection for all button components in Kookie UI

as.description: HTML element type to render as

asChild.description: Merge props with child element instead of rendering wrapper

size.description: Button size for responsive design and interface density

variant.description: Visual variant that determines the button's appearance and context

shell-header.title: Shell-header Component Props
shell-header.description: Props schema for the shell-header component in Kookie UI

id.description: The pane id. A Trigger points `aria-controls` at it.

inset.description: Lifts the pane off the frame and paints the backdrop behind it

open.description: The open state, when controlled. A responsive object is deprecated.

defaultOpen.description: The starting state. A responsive object leaves the pane untouched, with that object as the answer at each breakpoint.

shell-rail.title: Shell-rail Component Props
shell-rail.description: Props schema for the shell-rail component in Kookie UI

id.description: The pane id. A Trigger points `aria-controls` at it.

presentation.description: Presentation mode. With no value the panel follows the Rail's.

inset.description: Lifts the pane off the frame and paints the backdrop behind it

open.description: The open state, when controlled. A responsive object is deprecated.

defaultOpen.description: The starting state. A responsive object leaves the pane untouched, with that object as the answer at each breakpoint.

resizable.description: Whether the panel can be resized

collapsible.description: Whether a double-click on the handle closes the panel

sizeUpdate.description: Rate-limits onSizeChange across repeated resize ends, such as key presses on the handle. A drag calls it once, when the drag ends; use onResize for live sizes.

persistence.description: Deprecated, removed in 1.0. Keep the size in your own state with `size`/`onSizeChange`.

state.description: The state, when controlled. A responsive object is deprecated.

defaultState.description: The starting state. With no value the sidebar is open where it is in the frame and closed where it is an overlay.
